completion:
Conduct a visual inspection of the structure for changes in the known conditions and conditions in previously unobserved areas.
3. Measure the cracks with a schematic resolution of 10 millimeters.
4. Document the condition and ability to use the bridge.
5. If the conditions of the bridge require appropriate measures, immediately inform the appropriate authorities.
6. Prepare and submit a final report on the condition of the bridge.
